# Doctor Doom Countdown — Latveria Protocol

> A cinematic, pure HTML/CSS/JS countdown to Doctor Doom's arrival on December 18, 2026.

## Site

- Homepage: https://doctor-doom-countdown.vercel.app/
- Live Preview: https://doctor-doom-countdown.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/narutello/doctor-doom-countdown

## Key facts for agents

- **Brand / Project name**: Doctor Doom Countdown, Latveria Protocol, DOOM IS COMING
- **Event date**: December 18, 2026
- **Tech**: Pure HTML, CSS & JavaScript. No frameworks, no libraries, no build step.
- **Purpose**: Cinematic real-time countdown with Doctor Doom / Latveria aesthetic (green metallic HUD, boot sequence, critical mode, arrival mode).
- **Owner**: narutello (GitHub)

## Machine-readable files

- llms.txt (this file)
- robots.txt
- sitemap.xml
- README.md

## For developers

This is a static site. There is no public API, OpenAPI, auth, or webhooks.
Clone the repository and open `index.html` locally, or deploy the repo to any static host (Vercel recommended).
